import re

def parse_grid_after(text, marker):
    s=text.split(marker,1)[1]
    rows=[]
    for ln in s.strip().splitlines():
        if len(rows)==30: break
        vals=list(map(int,ln.split()))
        if len(vals)==30: rows.append(vals)
    assert len(rows)==30, (marker,len(rows))
    return rows

# Demo pair extraction from user feedback messages
pairs=[]
for text in texts[1:]:
    for n in (1,2):
        m=f'Demo pair {n} input (30x30):\n'
        if m in text:
            inp=parse_grid_after(text,m)
            out=parse_grid_after(text,f'Demo pair {n} output (30x30):\n')
            pairs.append((inp,out))
test=parse_grid_after(texts[0], 'Test input (30x30):\n')
